All three acceptance checks pass. Here's a complete summary of what was accomplished in **T3.4**:

---

## Task T3.4 — Results Summary

### Key Numerical Findings

| Diagnostic | Value | Interpretation |
|---|---|---|
| **Spearman ρ** | **0.7143** | Strong positive rank correlation — Δ becomes less negative as N grows |
| **Two-tailed p** | **0.0713** | Marginally significant (< 0.10); limited power with n = 7 |
| **Concordance count** | **7 / 7** | Both seeds agree on sign (all negative) at every size |
| **Concordance fraction** | **1.0000 (100%)** | Perfect seed agreement — augmentation-hurts finding is not a seed artefact |
| **Epoch-1 aug > noaug loss** | **14 / 14 (100%)** | Augmentation raises epoch-1 training loss in every single configuration |

### Diagnostic Narrative
- **Spearman ρ = 0.71** confirms a monotone trend toward smaller benefit magnitude at larger N — consistent with the log-linear OLS model from T3.3.
- **Perfect concordance (7/7)** shows both seeds uniformly agree: augmentation is harmful at 5 epochs across all tested sizes.
- **14/14 epoch-1 loss comparisons** show augmented runs start with higher loss — the fundamental cause of negative Δ is harder per-step learning, not overfitting in the noaug condition.

### Artifact Produced
- **`analysis/trend_diagnostics.txt`** — 79-line report with sections `[SPEARMAN]`, `[CONCORDANCE]`, and `[EPOCH1_LOSS]`, all with numerical values and interpretations
